issue_context.title: API: /org/{org}/repos is inconsistent with the rest of the api
issue_context.body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): 1.11.0+dev-213-g173da1b5a
- Git version: 2.22.0
- Operating system: linux
- Database (use `[x]`):
  - [ ] PostgreSQL
  - [ ] MySQL
  - [ ] MSSQL
  - [x] SQLite
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:
  - [ ] Yes
  - [ ] No
  - [x] Not relevant

## Description

The api for creating a new repo for an organisation uses the /api/v1/org/{org} prefix instead of the /api/v1/orgs/{org} prefix like the rest of the api. 

I have an (untested) change in my fork: https://github.com/ederuiter/gitea which deprecates the /api/v1/org/{org}/repos call and adds a new /api/v1/orgs/{org}/repos call. If this is something you want I can test it and create a pull request for it.
